settings.title: Congregation settings
settings.subtitle: Changes here affect the whole congregation and are recorded in the audit log.

goals.title: Goal defaults
goals.description: These are the monthly hour goals publishers see until they set a personal goal. A snapshot is kept on each submitted report, so changing a default never rewrites past months.
goals.auxiliaryDescription: A publisher requesting auxiliary service picks one of these two figures for that arrangement.

window.title: Window rules
window.description: Controls when a monthly report counts as on time or late, and whether leftover minutes in the daily log carry over to the next month. Changes apply to future months only.
window.onTimeDayLabel: On-time day of the following month
window.carryOverDescription: When a report matches the whole hours from the daily log, the leftover minutes are added to next month's log as a labelled entry. A publisher can still turn this off for their own log.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: A reminder always goes out on the opening day in addition to the days below. Nothing is pushed during quiet hours — it waits until the next morning.
reminders.scheduleDaysHint: Comma-separated days of the month, for example 3, 5, 8, 10.
reminders.finalCallLabel: Final-call hour on the on-time day (24-hour)
reminders.weeklyDescription: Until the report is submitted or the month is closed.

general.landingDescription: Shown to visitors before they sign in — meeting times, address and contact line. No meeting details are invented; leave a field blank rather than guess.
general.letterheadDescription: Appears on the congregation PDF and Excel exports and the individual service-year record.
general.letterheadLinesHint: One line per line of text. Up to six lines.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Service groups are a filter, not a ranking. Retiring a group keeps its history; it never deletes anything.
groups.empty: No groups yet. Add the first one below.
